title: Research: certify the helper stabilizer required at a live ERASE cut
body:
Eventual helper restoration does not suffice for a live COPY/ERASE interval. This proves the exact stabilizer condition at ERASE and supplies source-bound endpoint-preserving mutants for all nine PR1062 intervals, which the chronological lifecycle checker rejects. It includes the complete GL4 census, 322,560 dirty assignments, the full 661-column endpoint and positive repairs.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fe864fe0d8600827cf03dfe78d2131dbe8745a71/research/bit-copy-live-stabilizer/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
